name: suede-community-marketing
description: Suede AI community-growth discipline: member identity and purpose, platform choice (Discord, Slack, Circle, Reddit, Discourse, Facebook Groups), founding-member seeding, rituals and core loop, moderation and enforcement paths, health metrics with denominators, ambassador programs, and public community content that search engines and AI answers surface. Use when starting, auditing, or growing a product or brand community. NOT FOR: public social-channel content (use suede-social), referral-program
author: JasonColapietro
